reasons: The principle of changing the first floor from residential use to community use is considered acceptable within the Residential Policy Area because the non-residential use would be of an appropriate scale and would retain and expand the existing community facility, according with Doncaster Local Plan Policies 10 and 51.

The proposal would not cause unacceptable harm to residential amenity: no external alterations are proposed, the building does not share walls with adjoining properties, the expanded community use is not expected to generate harmful noise or disturbance, and rear parking movements would use an existing contained yard onto Brook Street. The development therefore accords with Doncaster Local Plan Policies 10, 42 and 44 and NPPF paragraph 130.

The proposal is acceptable in highway and parking terms because the rear yard would provide off-street parking sufficient to meet Appendix 6 requirements, and the central Hexthorpe location is highly sustainable and accessible to local residents by non-car modes, according with Doncaster Local Plan Policy 13.

Flood risk is acceptable because only part of the land lies in Flood Zone 2, the building itself is not within the flood zone, and the change of use with no operational development is minor development involving a less vulnerable use, so the sequential and exception tests are not required under NPPF paragraph 176 and footnote 62.
The proposal would not harm the character or appearance of the area because it involves a change of use only with no external alterations to the building.
conditions: The development must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission. Reason: Condition required to be imposed by Section 91, as amended, of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

The development hereby permitted must be carried out and completed entirely in accordance with the terms of this permission and the details shown on the approved plans and specifications: Location Plan received 06/02/2026; Existing / Proposed Floor Plans (Ground Floor) received 06/02/2026; Proposed Floor Plans (First Floor) received 06/02/2026; and Parking Arrangements received 16/03/2026. Reason: To ensure that the development is carried out in accordance with the application as approved.
